text: In accordance with the Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors By-law 1-2021, the Board determines the place in Toronto, day, and hour of its regular meetings and the schedule of those meetings shall be publicly available by the first meeting of the Board in each calendar year. City Council on October 11 and 12, 2023 approved the 2024 schedule of meetings for City Council and its Committees. The 2024 schedule of meetings for the Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors has been developed to avoid dates, whenever possible, that conflict with the approved City Council schedule; and to avoid meetings on days of cultural or religious significance. The following meetings of the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority have been scheduled for 2024: Tuesday, March 26 - 9:30 am Tuesday, May 28 - 9:30 am Friday, July 19 - 9:30 am Friday, October 18 -9:30 am Friday, November 29…
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority received the item for information.
